quarterly_data.signal: 10-K results for fiscal 2025 (in thousands): total revenue was $170,155 versus $227,043 in 2024 and $251,455 in 2023. Biosecurity segment service revenue fell to $37,409 from $53,071, with a Biosecurity operating loss of $(18,931) versus $(30,619); the Cell Engineering operating loss narrowed to $(95,530) from $(218,567). Research and development expenses were $243.8 million versus $424.1 million, and net loss was $(312,763) versus $(547,029).
